STEP 1 - Vessel type: flat plate (white, rim band visible, flat centre, no inner wall). Its corners are rounded, so it is a rounded-square plate.

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: a rounded-square dinner plate is about 25-27 cm. The plate here is large relative to the food, so I take roughly 26 cm across.
b) Reference: the pizza slice is about 20 cm along its long edge, and the chicken pieces are about 2-4 cm each. The plate spans about the length of the pizza slice plus the food cluster, consistent with about 25-27 cm.
Final width: 26 cm. Area: about 26 x 26 = 676 cm2 (square approximation, corners removed gives about 620 cm2 usable).

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Pizza slice (one wedge, about 1/8 of a 30 cm pizza, or roughly 1/4 of a 20 cm personal pizza): footprint about 14 x 9 cm = 126 cm2 at a triangular shape, roughly 90 cm2 effective. Thickness about 1.5 cm (crust edge). Volume about 90 x 1.5 = 135 ml x 0.3 (bread-like crust density, but with cheese and toppings I use 0.6) = about 80 g. Count check: one slice of pizza is typically 80-100 g, so I use 90 g.
- Chicken pieces with sauce: the cluster covers roughly 35% of the plate, about 220 cm2. Average thickness about 2 cm (pieces stacked about 1-2 deep). Volume 220 x 2 = 440 ml x 1.0 = about 440 g. Visible sauce adds a little, but the pieces are mostly hidden by the sauce coating. I estimate the chicken at about 300 g, with the thick mound in the centre being most of it.
- Vegetables (Brussels sprouts, zucchini, yellow squash, dried red chili): about 10% of the plate, about 60 cm2 at 1 cm average thickness = 60 ml x 0.6 = about 36 g; I round to 50 g to include the sauce and pepper pieces.
- Sauce: a thin smear across the plate, about 100 cm2 x 0.3 cm = 30 ml x 1.0 = about 30 g.

Total food: about 90 + 300 + 50 + 30 = 470 g.

Energy per 100 g (estimates):
- Pizza with cheese, mushroom, onion: about 260 kcal/100 g.
- Chicken in a sauce (stir-fried, coated): about 180 kcal/100 g.
- Vegetables, stir-fried: about 60 kcal/100 g.
- Sauce (oil-based stir-fry sauce): about 90 kcal/100 g.
